description: This file defines an abstract test case class 'TestCaseAbstract' for SuiteCRM, extending PHPUnit's TestCase and incorporating database transaction management and database refresh traits. It includes setup and teardown methods with verbose output and error handling for database cleanup strategies.

classes.name: SuiteCRM\TestCaseAbstract
classes.description: An abstract class for SuiteCRM test cases, providing setup and teardown logic with database transaction handling and verbosity control.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment, manages database transactions based on cleanup strategy, and outputs verbose info.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Cleans up after tests, rolling back transactions if applicable, and outputs verbose info.
